He is known for his roles as divorce attorney Arnold Becker on the NBC drama series "L.A. Law", as Dr. Alan Feinstone in "The Dentist", as retired police detective Henry Spencer on the USA Network comedy-drama series "Psych", and as Roger Dorn in the films "Major League", "Major League II", and "".
